About the Scholarship

SUFONAMA qualifies graduates for integrated management of forests and natural areas in a landscape context, coordinated from Copenhagen with European forestry partners. The current cycle uses 15 January (non-EU/EEA/Switzerland) and 1 March (EU/EEA/Switzerland) deadlines, a pattern the 2027 round is expected to repeat.

OpportunitySUFONAMA – Erasmus Mundus Master in Sustainable Forest and Nature Management
HostSUFONAMA Consortium
LocationCopenhagen (multi-country mobility), Denmark
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected non-EU

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

SUFONAMA qualifies graduates for integrated management of forests and natural areas in a landscape context, coordinated from Copenhagen with European forestry partners. The current cycle uses 15 January (non-EU/EEA/Switzerland) and 1 March (EU/EEA/Switzerland) deadlines, a pattern the 2027 round is expected to repeat.

Programme Highlights

  • Danish-coordinated forestry and nature management master
  • Two-tier deadlines: mid-January for non-EU, early March for EU applicants
  • Field courses across European forest ecosystems
  • Careers in forest governance, conservation agencies and certification bodies

Who Should Apply

Forestry, biology, environmental and natural-resource graduates fit the programme; English evidence follows the University of Copenhagen's standards.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected non-EU applicants in the January round: tuition plus allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the SUFONAMA application page and keep the non-EU January date in mind if you need scholarship consideration. Key deadline information: 15 January 2027 (non-EU/EEA, expected); 1 March 2027 (EU/EEA, expected) — mirrors the current cycle.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About SUFONAMA Consortium

The SUFONAMA consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Sustainable Forest and Nature Management with Danish coordination and European forestry universities.

Official website: https://sufonama-em.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

  • A 12-Month Study Abroad Application Plan for Master's and PhD Applicants
